title: Show HN: Graphicle, a Rust port of Graphify with memory for coding agents
title_zh: Show HN：Graphicle，一个为编码智能体设计的、带有内存功能的 Graphify Rust 移植版

paragraphs.en: Code graph and memory for your coding agents, in one Rust program. For Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and any MCP client.
paragraphs.zh: 为你的编码智能体提供代码图与记忆，集成于一个 Rust 程序中。 支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 以及任何 MCP 客户端。

sents.en: Code graph and memory for your coding agents, in one Rust program.
sents.zh: 为你的编码智能体提供代码图与记忆，集成于一个 Rust 程序中。

sents.en: For Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and any MCP client.
sents.zh: 支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 以及任何 MCP 客户端。

paragraphs.en: Graphicle maps your repository into a code graph, remembers your project's docs, decisions and past agent sessions, and gives your coding agent cited excerpts from both: the exact files and lines. It runs on your machine: no API key needed, no account, no telemetry . Works with Claude Code · Cursor · Codex · VS Code · Claude Desktop · any MCP client
paragraphs.zh: Graphicle 将你的代码仓库映射为代码图谱，记住你项目的文档、决策以及过往的智能体会话，并为你的编码智能体提供两者的引用摘录：确切的文件和行号。 它在你的本地机器上运行：无需 API 密钥，无需账户，无遥测数据收集。 兼容 Claude Code · Cursor · Codex · VS Code · Claude Desktop · 任何 MCP 客户端

paragraphs.en: Graphicle 0.1.8 against 0.1.7 on kubernetes (a shallow clone at ca8a2a9e4 ), the 22 questions of issue #8 , our Linux server: a median of 1.34 s per graphicle context call on 16 cores, against 2.99 s, each call a new process. Method and every row
paragraphs.zh: Graphicle 0.1.8 对比 0.1.7，运行于 kubernetes（位于 ca8a2a9e4 的浅克隆），针对 issue #8 的 22 个问题，在我们的 Linux 服务器上：16 核时每次 graphicle context 调用的中位耗时为 1.34 秒，对比 2.99 秒，每次调用均启动一个新进程。方法与每一行

paragraphs.en: brew install graphicle-ai/tap/graphicle cd your-repo graphicle setup No Homebrew? curl -fsSL https://github.com/graphicle-ai/graphicle/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh · Release archives · Other ways to install Windows: a preview build for x86-64, not yet code-signed ( Windows (preview) ).

paragraphs.en: graphicle setup indexes the repository, builds its code graph and connects the coding agents it finds. It also turns on session capture, adds a two-line section to AGENTS.md (unless Claude Code is the only agent) and installs Git hooks that keep the project current. It lists every file it changes and backs each one up first; graphicle disconnect undoes it all.
paragraphs.zh: graphicle 会为代码仓库建立索引，构建其代码图谱，并连接它所发现的各个智能体。 它还会开启会话捕获，在 AGENTS.md 中添加一个两行的段落（除非 Claude Code 是唯一的智能体），并安装能让项目保持最新的 Git 钩子。 它会列出它更改的每个文件，并事先对每个文件进行备份；graphicle disconnect 可以撤销所有更改。

paragraphs.en: Then ask your agent to "use graphicle to find where failed requests are retried" , or ask from the terminal:
paragraphs.zh: 然后让你的智能体「使用 graphicle 查找失败请求在哪里被重试」，或者在终端中询问：

paragraphs.en: $ graphicle ask " where is tax added to prices? " Evidence for "where is tax added to prices?" 4 excerpts · 606 of 3,000 tokens [1] shop/pricing.py:1-7 price_with_tax() """Prices and tax.""" TAX_RATE = 0.2 def price_with_tax(price): """A price with the sales tax added.""" return round(price * (1 + TAX_RATE), 2) Real output, cut after the first excerpt. With no model configured, ask shows the evidence; graphicle config set model anthropic (or openai , ollama ) adds written answers.
paragraphs.zh: $ graphicle ask “税是在哪里加到价格里的？ ” “税是在哪里加到价格里的？”的证据 4 个摘录 · 3,000 个 token 中已用 606 [1] shop/pricing.py:1-7 price_with_tax() """Prices and tax.""" TAX_RATE = 0.2 def price_with_tax(price): """A price with the sales tax added.""" return round(price * (1 + TAX_RATE), 2) 真实输出，在第一个摘录后截断。 在未配置模型时，ask 只显示证据；通过 graphicle config set model anthropic（或 openai、ollama）即可添加书面回答。

paragraphs.en: Install Graphicle with `brew install graphicle-ai/tap/graphicle` (or, without Homebrew, `curl -fsSL https://github.com/graphicle-ai/graphicle/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh`), then run `graphicle setup --yes` in this repository and list every file it changed. Start here You want to Run Give your coding agent the code graph and your project's memory graphicle setup in the repository Ask a question from the terminal graphicle ask "how are failed requests retried?" Browse the graph, the sources and the memory graphicle open See what a change to a symbol touches graphicle graph extract . --code-only , then graphicle graph affected "retry()" Check that everything works graphicle doctor Undo everything setup did graphicle disconnect Move from Graphify, or run a server for a team Moving from Graphify · Team server Why Graphicle Native and fast. One Rust program. On 13 codebases, Graphicle's 0.1.1 memory engine (a pre-release build) took 3.0 to 22.7 times less time than Graphify 0.9.91 in all 39 measurements (code-only extract, priming update and update with no change, on the same machine with 3 CPUs and 8 workers each). The graphs differ slightly: node counts within 4.7%, edge counts within 2.0% ( speed table ). A later pre-release build with 0.1.1's memory changes, whose graphs also differ from Graphify's, used less peak memory than Graphify 0.9.91 in all 39 measurements, from 0.29 to 0.97 times Graphify's figure ( memory table ). Cited context, within a budget you set. Your agent asks Graphicle and gets the relevant code, docs and decisions as cited excerpts, within a token budget you set. In our tests it tied grep on finding code, and we do not claim it saves tokens ( what we measured ). Answers you can check. Every excerpt names its file and lines. Memories an agent proposes wait for your approval. One program, not a stack. The code graph, the memory, one MCP server, the web app and the command line come in one install, with one SQLite file. No Python, Docker or database server. Local and private. No account and no telemetry. Your code and data leave your machine only when you ask. The only automatic request is a daily check for a new release, which GRAPHICLE_NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1 turns off. What it does Code graph. Files, functions, classes, calls and imports, parsed with tree-sitter and no model. graphicle graph searches it, explains a symbol, traces a path and exports an interactive HTML graph. After graphicle graph extract .
paragraphs.zh: 使用 `brew install graphicle-ai/tap/graphicle` 安装 Graphicle（若无 Homebrew，则使用 `curl -fsSL https://github.com/graphicle-ai/graphicle/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh`），然后在此仓库中运行 `graphicle setup --yes`，并列出它更改的每个文件。 从这里开始 你想 运行 为你的编码智能体提供代码图谱和项目记忆 在仓库中运行 graphicle setup 从终端提问 graphicle ask "how are failed requests retried?" 浏览图谱、源代码和记忆 graphicle open 查看对某个符号的更改会影响到什么 graphicle graph extract . --code-only，然后运行 graphicle graph affected "retry()" 检查一切是否正常 graphicle doctor 撤销 setup 所做的一切 graphicle disconnect 从 Graphify 迁移，或为团队运行服务器 从 Graphify 迁移 · 团队服务器 为什么选择 Graphicle 原生且快速。一个 Rust 程序。 在 13 个代码库上，Graphicle 0.1.1 的记忆引擎（预发布版本）在全部 39 项测量中（仅代码提取、预热更新和无变更更新，均在同一台机器上，各使用 3 个 CPU 和 8 个工作进程）比 Graphify 0.9.91 少用 3.0 到 22.7 倍的时间。 两者的图谱略有差异：节点数相差在 4.7% 以内，边数相差在 2.0% 以内（速度表）。 一个包含 0.1.1 记忆变更的较新预发布版本，其图谱也与 Graphify 的不同，在全部 39 项测量中使用的峰值内存都低于 Graphify 0.9.91，仅为 Graphify 数值的 0.29 到 0.97 倍（内存表）。 引用式上下文，且在你设定的预算之内。 你的智能体向 Graphicle 提问，即可获得以引用形式呈现的相关代码、文档和决策，且不超过你设定的 token 预算。 在我们的测试中，它在查找代码方面与 grep 相当，我们也不声称它能节省 token（我们测量了什么）。可核验的回答。 每个摘录都标明其文件和行号。 智能体提出的记忆会等待你的批准。 一个程序，而非一堆组件。 代码图谱、记忆、一个 MCP 服务器、Web 应用和命令行，一次安装全部包含，且只有一个 SQLite 文件。 无需 Python、Docker 或数据库服务器。本地且私密。 无需账户，也没有遥测。 只有在你主动要求时，你的代码和数据才会离开你的机器。 唯一的自动请求是每日检查新版本，可通过 GRAPHICLE_NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1 关闭。它的功能 代码图谱。 文件、函数、类、调用和导入，使用 tree-sitter 解析，不使用模型。graphicle graph 可搜索它、解释符号、追踪路径并导出交互式 HTML 图谱。 在 graphicle graph extract . 之后。

paragraphs.en: --code-only , graphicle graph affected "retry()" lists what depends on a symbol. Project memory. Docs (Markdown, PDF, Office, HTML), reviewed decisions and procedures, and past Claude Code and Codex sessions, searchable alongside the code. Cited context on a budget. graphicle context and the MCP tools return excerpts with their sources, within a token budget, without calling a model. One MCP server. graphicle mcp serves the code-graph tools, under Graphify's tool names such as query_graph , get_neighbors and shortest_path , next to the memory tools. With --pull-requests it also serves the pull-request tools list_prs , get_pr_impact and triage_prs , which use the GitHub CLI ( MCP ). Memory tied to your code. Reviewed memories are tied to the functions they are about: a memory goes stale when that code changes, and edits elsewhere in the file usually leave it current ( the exact rule ). Mentions of code in your docs are linked to the definitions they name ( graphicle call graph.doc_links lists them). Across repositories. Recall can span the repositories of a workspace: graphicle context --workspace , or the workspace MCP endpoint . Always current. Before each answer Graphicle syncs the few files you changed; Git hooks sync after each commit, merge and checkout. Sessions carry over. Session capture keeps each finished turn, and once you have reviewed memories, each new session starts with them and the latest turns. An app. graphicle open shows the graph, the sources and the memory in your browser. It is where you approve memories. Works with your agents graphicle setup connects every client it finds over MCP. Each file is backed up once as <file>.graphicle-bak , and graphicle disconnect removes what it added.
paragraphs.zh: --code-only，graphicle graph 会受影响地列出哪些内容依赖某个符号的 "retry()"。项目记忆。 文档（Markdown、PDF、Office、HTML）、经过审阅的决策与流程，以及过往的 Claude Code 和 Codex 会话，可与代码一同检索。 在预算内返回带引用的上下文。graphicle context 和 MCP 工具在 token 预算内返回摘录及其来源，且无需调用模型。 一个 MCP 服务器。graphicle mcp 以 Graphify 的工具名称（如 query_graph、get_neighbors 和 shortest_path）提供代码图谱工具，与记忆工具并列。 使用 --pull-requests 时，它还会提供拉取请求工具 list_prs、get_pr_impact 和 triage_prs，这些工具通过 GitHub CLI（MCP）工作。 与你的代码绑定的记忆。 经过审阅的记忆与其涉及的函数绑定：当该代码变更时记忆会过期，而文件中其他位置的编辑通常不会使其失效（确切规则）。 文档中对代码的提及会被链接到它们所指的定义（graphicle call graph.doc_links 可列出这些链接）。支持跨仓库。 召回可跨越工作区中的多个仓库：通过 graphicle context --workspace，或工作区 MCP 端点。始终保持最新。 每次回答前 Graphicle 会同步你改动的少数文件；Git 钩子会在每次提交、合并和检出后进行同步。会话得以延续。 会话捕获会保留每一轮已完成的对话，一旦你审阅了记忆，每个新会话都会以这些记忆和最近的对话轮次开始。 一个应用。graphicle open 会在你的浏览器中展示图谱、源代码和记忆。 这里是你批准记忆的地方。 与你的智能体协同工作。graphicle setup 会通过 MCP 连接它找到的每个客户端。 每个文件会以 <file>.graphicle-bak 备份一次，graphicle disconnect 会移除它所添加的内容。

sents.en: Reviewed memories are tied to the functions they are about: a memory goes stale when that code changes, and edits elsewhere in the file usually leave it current ( the exact rule ).
sents.zh: 经过审阅的记忆与其涉及的函数绑定：当该代码变更时记忆会过期，而文件中其他位置的编辑通常不会使其失效（确切规则）。

sents.en: Mentions of code in your docs are linked to the definitions they name ( graphicle call graph.doc_links lists them). Across repositories.
sents.zh: 文档中对代码的提及会被链接到它们所指的定义（graphicle call graph.doc_links 可列出这些链接）。支持跨仓库。

sents.en: Recall can span the repositories of a workspace: graphicle context --workspace , or the workspace MCP endpoint . Always current.
sents.zh: 召回可跨越工作区中的多个仓库：通过 graphicle context --workspace，或工作区 MCP 端点。始终保持最新。

sents.en: Before each answer Graphicle syncs the few files you changed; Git hooks sync after each commit, merge and checkout. Sessions carry over.
sents.zh: 每次回答前 Graphicle 会同步你改动的少数文件；Git 钩子会在每次提交、合并和检出后进行同步。会话得以延续。

sents.en: Session capture keeps each finished turn, and once you have reviewed memories, each new session starts with them and the latest turns.
sents.zh: 会话捕获会保留每一轮已完成的对话，一旦你审阅了记忆，每个新会话都会以这些记忆和最近的对话轮次开始。

sents.en: An app. graphicle open shows the graph, the sources and the memory in your browser.
sents.zh: 一个应用。graphicle open 会在你的浏览器中展示图谱、源代码和记忆。

sents.en: It is where you approve memories.
sents.zh: 这里是你批准记忆的地方。

sents.en: Works with your agents graphicle setup connects every client it finds over MCP.
sents.zh: 与你的智能体协同工作。graphicle setup 会通过 MCP 连接它找到的每个客户端。

sents.en: Each file is backed up once as <file>.graphicle-bak , and graphicle disconnect removes what it added.
sents.zh: 每个文件会以 <file>.graphicle-bak 备份一次，graphicle disconnect 会移除它所添加的内容。

paragraphs.en: The left column is a code-graph tool, such as Graphify's open-source engine, plus a separate memory server. It is not a comparison with Graphify Cloud, a hosted service that includes memory.
paragraphs.zh: 左侧栏是一个代码图谱工具，例如 Graphify 的开源引擎，外加一个独立的记忆服务器。 它并不是与 Graphify Cloud 的比较，Graphify Cloud 是一项包含记忆功能的托管服务。

paragraphs.en: Every figure is labelled, and docs/benchmarks.md has the full tables, methods and limits. In the agent tests, a difference counts only when its 95% interval excludes 0; otherwise it is a tie. Long sessions and memory built up across coding sessions are not tested yet.
paragraphs.zh: 每张图都带有标注，docs/benchmarks.md 中包含完整的表格、方法与局限。 在智能体测试中，只有当差值的 95% 区间不包含 0 时才计为差异，否则视为平局。 长会话以及跨编码会话积累的记忆尚未经过测试。

paragraphs.en: Offline ranking, 100 SWE-bench Verified issues never used for tuning. Graphicle 0.1.8 put a file the fix changed in its first 5 files for 75 issues, against 61 for BM25 (SWE-bench style), a significant difference (McNemar exact p = 0.013); for the first file (43 vs 35) and the first 10 (81 vs 77) the differences are not significant. This measures ranking, not whether a coding agent fixes more issues; no agent test of this ranking has been run yet ( method, task lists and limits ).
paragraphs.zh: 离线排序，100 个未用于调优的 SWE-bench Verified 问题。 Graphicle 0.1.8 在 75 个问题上把修复所改动的文件排进其前 5 个文件中，而 BM25（SWE-bench 风格）为 61 个，差异显著（McNemar 精确检验 p = 0.013）；对于首个文件（43 对 35）和前 10 个文件（81 对 77），差异不显著。 这衡量的是排序，而不是某个智能体是否能修复更多问题；目前尚未针对该排序运行智能体测试（方法、任务列表与局限）。

paragraphs.en: No, for most of it. The code graph (with --code-only ), sync, context , the MCP server, session capture and the app work without one. A model writes the answers of graphicle ask , proposes memories from sources and reads documents and images in a full graphicle graph extract . Local models through Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible server work ( configuration ).
paragraphs.zh: 不，大部分功能不需要。 代码图（使用 --code-only）、同步、context、MCP 服务器、会话捕获以及应用都可以在没有模型的情况下工作。 模型用于生成 graphicle ask 的回答、从来源中提议记忆，并在完整的 graphicle graph extract 中读取文档和图像。 通过 Ollama 或任何兼容 OpenAI 的服务器使用的本地模型也可以工作（配置）。

sents.en: No, for most of it.
sents.zh: 不，大部分功能不需要。

paragraphs.en: The code-graph engine is a Rust port of Graphify, credited in its file headers and in NOTICE . It follows Graphify 0.9.95, and later Graphify releases are ported in later versions; the parity checks compare it with that release. The memory, the memory tools, the app and session capture are not part of Graphify. Coming from Graphify? graphicle setup offers to switch a repository, backs up each file and never deletes graphify-out/ ( Moving from Graphify ).
paragraphs.zh: 代码图引擎是 Graphify 的 Rust 移植版，在其文件头部和 NOTICE 中均有署名。 它对应 Graphify 0.9.95，后续的 Graphify 版本会在后续版本中移植；一致性检查将该实现与该版本进行对比。 记忆、记忆工具、应用与会话捕获均不属于 Graphify 的组成部分。 从 Graphify 迁移过来？graphicle setup 提供仓库切换功能，会备份每个文件且从不删除 graphify-out/（从 Graphify 迁移）。

sents.zh: 记忆、记忆工具、应用与会话捕获均不属于 Graphify 的组成部分。

sents.en: Coming from Graphify? graphicle setup offers to switch a repository, backs up each file and never deletes graphify-out/ ( Moving from Graphify ).
sents.zh: 从 Graphify 迁移过来？graphicle setup 提供仓库切换功能，会备份每个文件且从不删除 graphify-out/（从 Graphify 迁移）。

paragraphs.en: By default a project can hold up to 100,000 text files and 1 GiB of text; you can raise both (see Limits in docs/configuration.md ). A very large file is analysed in part or kept as searchable text instead of stopping a sync.
paragraphs.zh: 默认情况下，一个项目最多可容纳 100,000 个文本文件和 1 GiB 的文本；你可以提高这两个上限（参见 docs/configuration.md 中的限制说明）。 对于非常大的文件，系统会部分分析或将其保留为可搜索文本，而不是中止同步。

paragraphs.en: The code: crates/graphicle/ (the program: command line, app, HTTP and MCP server), crates/graphicle-graph/ (the code-graph engine), crates/graphicle-memory/ (the memory library), SDKs for Python and TypeScript , and a team server recipe in deploy/ . Each crate builds on its own ( building from source ).
paragraphs.zh: 代码包括：crates/graphicle/（程序本体：命令行、应用、HTTP 与 MCP 服务器）、crates/graphicle-graph/（代码图谱引擎）、crates/graphicle-memory/（记忆库）、面向 Python 和 TypeScript 的 SDK，以及 deploy/ 目录下的团队服务器部署方案。 每个 crate 都可以独立构建（从源码构建）。

paragraphs.en: Code signing policy : release builds are not yet signed with a trusted certificate. The Windows programs are signed through SignPath with a test certificate, which Windows does not trust, or left unsigned when that signing fails; each release's notes say which. Signing with the SignPath Foundation's certificate is planned. The policy also lists every case in which Graphicle contacts the network.
paragraphs.zh: 代码签名政策：发布版本尚未使用受信任的证书进行签名。 Windows 程序通过 SignPath 使用测试证书进行签名（Windows 不信任该证书），或在签名失败时保持未签名状态；每个版本的说明都会注明属于哪种情况。 计划使用 SignPath Foundation 的证书进行签名。 该政策还列出了 Graphicle 联网的每一种情况。
